en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1489 - It is narrated from The Prophet (sw) that He said:

"When Allah (swt), the Exalted, becomes angry with a nation but does not send punishment upon it, the prices of goods rise, their lifespans become shorter, their traders do not profit, their fruits do not flourish, their rivers do not flow abundantly, rain is withheld from them, and their wicked people are given authority over them."
